card.name: Household measuring units and dosing devices
card.fires_on: Words for kitchen-style measures and dosing tools, such as teaspoon, tablespoon, dropper and spoon. It often fires partway through these words, in instructions for liquid or mixed doses.

modes.label: Spoon measures
modes.description: Teaspoon or tablespoon (or part of the word) after an amount when giving a volume to mix or take.
modes.example: to approximately 1<< tablespoon>> (15 mL) of room temperature

modes.label: Dropper and spoon devices
modes.description: The end of dropper or spoon when naming a measuring device for oral liquids.
modes.example: Do not touch the dro<<pper>> tip to any surface.

card.writes: It seems to push toward measure-word and container-quantity tokens such as cup, bottle and 'an appropriate amount'.
card.plain: It lights up on everyday measuring words like teaspoon, tablespoon, dropper and spoon in liquid dosing instructions.
